intro: At Stormwind Keep, a report on the Defias Brotherhood carries the findings of a long investigation to the royal court. City Architect Baros Alexston entrusts it to the adventurer who uncovered the conspiracy.

p: City Architect Baros Alexston prepared a report for Stormwind's leaders after a long investigation into unrest in Westfall and nearby lands. He entrusted the document to the adventurer who unraveled the conspiracy. The report is carried to Stormwind Keep, where it is meant to accompany a personal audience about the conspirators' schemes and the danger they pose to the kingdom.
